broadcast_clock_slots_source_check.name: broadcast_clock_slots_source_check
broadcast_clock_slots_source_check.value:
("broadcast_clock_slots"."source_kind" = 'asset' and "broadcast_clock_slots"."media_asset_id" is not null)
        or ("broadcast_clock_slots"."source_kind" = 'category' and "broadcast_clock_slots"."media_category" is not null)
        or ("broadcast_clock_slots"."source_kind" = 'dynamic' and "broadcast_clock_slots"."dynamic_key" is not null)
        or ("broadcast_clock_slots"."source_kind" = 'live' and "broadcast_clock_slots"."live_source_id" is not null)
        or "broadcast_clock_slots"."source_kind" = 'break'

broadcast_graphic_layers_schedule_check.name: broadcast_graphic_layers_schedule_check
broadcast_graphic_layers_schedule_check.value: "broadcast_graphic_layers"."ends_at" is null or "broadcast_graphic_layers"."starts_at" is null or "broadcast_graphic_layers"."ends_at" > "broadcast_graphic_layers"."starts_at"

broadcast_media_assets_availability_chec.name: broadcast_media_assets_availability_check

broadcast_media_versions_dimensions_chec.name: broadcast_media_versions_dimensions_check
broadcast_media_versions_dimensions_chec.value: ("broadcast_media_versions"."width" is null or "broadcast_media_versions"."width" > 0) and ("broadcast_media_versions"."height" is null or "broadcast_media_versions"."height" > 0)

broadcast_media_versions_frame_rate_chec.name: broadcast_media_versions_frame_rate_check
broadcast_media_versions_frame_rate_chec.value: ("broadcast_media_versions"."frame_rate_numerator" is null or "broadcast_media_versions"."frame_rate_numerator" > 0) and ("broadcast_media_versions"."frame_rate_denominator" is null or "broadcast_media_versions"."frame_rate_denominator" > 0)

broadcast_program_items_source_check.name: broadcast_program_items_source_check
broadcast_program_items_source_check.value:

        or ("broadcast_program_items"."source_kind" = 'category' and "broadcast_program_items"."media_category" is not null)
        or ("broadcast_program_items"."source_kind" = 'dynamic' and "broadcast_program_items"."dynamic_key" is not null)
        or ("broadcast_program_items"."source_kind" = 'live' and "broadcast_program_items"."live_source_id" is not null)
        or "broadcast_program_items"."source_kind" = 'break'
